# Aevinite

> Aevinite is a software company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, founded on 28 July 2024 by Rishi Nakrani (Founder) and Jenish Patel (Co-Founder). It started under the name Infinite and was renamed Aevinite on 16 June 2026. Aevinite builds custom business software, SaaS products, websites and apps, 3D web experiences and AI automation. Tagline: "The beginning with no end." Website: https://www.aevinite.com

## Key facts

- Name: Aevinite (formerly Infinite)
- Founded: 28 July 2024, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
- Founder: Rishi Nakrani (https://www.linkedin.com/in/rishinakrani/)
- Co-Founder: Jenish Patel (https://www.linkedin.com/in/jenish-patel-a5608a398/)
- Renamed from Infinite to Aevinite: 16 June 2026
- Headquarters: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
- Industry: Software development
- Team size: 2-10
- Name meaning: derived from Aevum, a dimension of existence with a beginning but no end; it also echoes Infinite, the original name.
- Not to be confused with: aerinite (a mineral), Aevi (payments), Aevex (aerospace), aeVidi.

## What Aevinite does

- Web and app development: websites, web apps and mobile-friendly interfaces.
- Custom systems: business software built around how a company actually works.
- SaaS products for businesses, such as restaurant software.
- Process automation and AI integration: removing repetitive work and adding AI where it helps.
- Cloud platforms and growth infrastructure for products that need to scale.
- 3D and interactive web experiences.

## Work

- [Aevidine](https://www.aevinite.com/#projects): a complete restaurant platform. Guests order from a menu at the table, with the screens the kitchen, staff and owner use to run service.
- Multispeciality hospital website: a trust-first site with services, doctor profiles and appointment information.
- 4D Dish Explorer: an interactive viewer where each dish is a real 3D model you can rotate and explore.
- HackJudge: a hackathon management and judging platform for events, teams, judges and scoring.
- Sweet Bites (Neon Bakery): a scroll-driven 3D showcase.
